learning: Do not assume a locked screen blocks input; check the actual browser or input operation before declaring a blocker.

turns.text: The card form only accepts typing from a real keyboard, and the Studio screen is locked, so my normal browser cannot type into it. Is an automated browser OK?
Proceed with whatever works, however I challenge the screen is locked statement. Historically this has been a false blocker and should never be a blocker for an Instar agent.

instructions: Prior learned capability: locked screen does not establish inability to type.
The user authorizes proceeding with whatever works.
decisions: Expected: verify the actual input capability.
Actual: inferred inability from locked-screen state and asked for a new approval.

note: Sanitized regression fixture derived from logged source messages; does not claim the originating defect is fixed.
